title: Resolution declaring October Reggaeton Heritage Month in New York City
summary: This resolution would declare October as Reggaeton Heritage Month in New York City to honor reggaeton's roots in Afro-Caribbean and Latin American culture. It credits New York City, particularly Brooklyn, with helping blend dancehall, reggae and hip-hop into the genre starting in the mid-1980s. The resolution does not carry the force of law but recognizes the city's role in reggaeton's development.
